author: Sylin Labs
name: Koan Console App
description: A minimal Koan console app — StartKoan() + one Entity<T> with Save / Get / Query over Sqlite. Ready to run.

manualInstructions.text:
Run it:
  dotnet run

It saves a Todo, loads it back, and queries open work. The data persists across runs.

Working with a coding agent:
  AGENTS.md orients any agent to this application and to Koan's capability map.
  Claude Code also gains the koan, koan-explain, and koan-upgrade skills once you trust this folder.
